summary: Alibaba Group Holding Limited furnished a Form 6-K on October 7, 2026, attaching its September 2026 Hong Kong Stock Exchange Monthly Return (Exhibit 99.1) under Rule 13.25B of the HK Listing Rules; the US-equivalent disclosure is a routine current report on foreign-private-issuer share-count movements. Authorized share capital is unchanged at 32,000,000,000 ordinary shares of USD 0.000003125 par (USD 100,000), while issued shares rose by 16,970,596 to 19,901,959,514, with zero treasury shares, reflecting option exercises and other equity issuances. The company confirms compliance with the 25% minimum public float threshold. No special-situation transaction, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or deal terms were disclosed; no risk-arb angle applies.
